must: Demonstrated experience leading and developing high-performing software engineering teams (5-8 engineers)
Strong software engineering background in distributed systems
Expertise in full software development lifecycle (SDLC) for core file features
Experience with rigorous testing strategies and CI/CD health
Ability to collaborate with Product Management and global R&D teams
specs.hook: Pure Storage is accelerating growth into FY27, making this a critical hire to scale their FlashArray File services and empower global innovators with reliable, high-performance data management.
specs.scope: Management role leading a team of 5-8 engineers, collaborating with Product Management and global R&D.

roles.title: Data Engineer - Data Platform & AI Enablement
roles.why: Pozice Data Engineer v IT oblasti je přesně v zaměření agentury a lokalita odpovídá.
roles.summary: This Data Engineer role at Pure Storage is critical for building the foundational data platform that will power their new AI-driven, self-service analytics ecosystem, ensuring highly curated and trustworthy data for business users and intelligent applications.

must: 1-3 years hands-on data engineering/warehousing experience
Strong Python proficiency (Snowpark experience a plus)
Practical experience with Apache NiFi
Proficiency in SQL for data transformation and modeling
Experience with Snowflake data pipelines
specs.hook: Pure Storage is aggressively scaling its AI/analytics data platform; this role directly addresses the critical need for robust, trustworthy data foundations to support their strategic shift towards AI-driven self-service analytics and continued revenue growth.
specs.scope: Individual Contributor role, working closely with senior engineering team.

roles.title: Consulting Field Solutions Architect - AI/Analytics - North Central Enterprise
roles.why: Pozice je v IT a AI, ale je to spíše prodejní role a není v Česku.

roles.title: Cloud Native Technical Services Engineer
roles.why: Pozice je v IT, Software & Cloud a je v Praze.
roles.summary: This role is critical for ensuring seamless operation of Pure Storage's Portworx Kubernetes Data Services Platform, directly impacting customer success with mission-critical cloud-native applications across multi-cloud environments.

must: 2-4+ years in customer-facing technical support or SRE
Solid working knowledge of Kubernetes, OpenShift, Tanzu, or VMware container solutions
Experience with large-scale customer deployments in public/private clouds
Ability to troubleshoot multi-layer software stack issues
specs.hook: Pure Storage's aggressive growth into FY27 and strategic focus on hyperscalers and the AI ecosystem means this role is key to scaling their Portworx platform's customer support and market adoption.
specs.scope: Individual Contributor role focused on technical support and customer success for cloud-native data services.

roles.title: Cloud Native Architect, Portworx - NY/NJ
roles.why: Pozice je v IT, ale je remote a mimo trh agentury.

roles.title: Cloud Native Architect, Portworx - North Central
roles.why: Pozice je IT a Cloud, ale je remote a mimo trh agentury.

roles.title: C++ Engineer, File
roles.why: Pozice C++ Engineer v IT oblasti je přesně v zaměření agentury.
roles.summary: This C++ Engineer will be pivotal in evolving Pure Storage's FlashArray File services, focusing on high-performance, highly reliable system development for critical SMB/NFS workloads.

must: Strong C++ software engineering skills
Experience building backend, systems, or infrastructure software
Solid problem-solving skills in performance-sensitive environments
Ownership mindset across the full software lifecycle
Curiosity for complex storage and file-serving systems
specs.hook: Pure Storage is aggressively expanding its FlashArray File capabilities to meet accelerating growth and strategic AI ecosystem demands, requiring top-tier C++ talent to ensure high-performance and reliability.
specs.scope: Individual Contributor role, owning features from design to maintenance within the FlashArray File team.

roles.title: Backend Engineer, Secrets Management (C++/Java)
roles.why: Pozice Backend Engineer v IT je přesně v zaměření agentury.
roles.summary: Pure Storage is seeking a security-minded Backend Engineer to design and implement high-performance, highly reliable security features for their FlashArray product line, ensuring customer data integrity and system uptime.

must: Proficiency in C++, Java, or Python for systems programming
Experience with high-performance, highly reliable systems (six 9s)
Ability to own and deliver product security features end-to-end
Experience in related systems software projects (e.g., Distributed Systems, OS, Linux Kernel)
specs.hook: This role directly addresses the critical need to enhance FlashArray's security posture and extend its value into cloud environments, a key strategic imperative for Pure Storage's continued growth and market leadership.
specs.scope: Individual Contributor role within the FlashArray team, focused on product security features.

roles.title: Associate Value Consultant
roles.why: Pozice je v IT, ale zaměření na finanční poradenství a lokalita v zahraničí ji činí okrajovou.

roles.title: AI QA Engineer
roles.why: Pozice AI QA Engineer je v souladu se zaměřením agentury na IT, Software & Cloud a lokalitou Praha.
roles.summary: This AI QA Engineer role at Pure Storage is critical for ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of their intelligent data management platform, directly impacting their expansion into the AI era. The position focuses on developing automated testing solutions for AI-driven features, transforming complex data into trusted, AI-ready information.

must: Experience designing, implementing, testing, and operating software applications or platform components.
Proficiency in designing quality strategies for AI-driven features, including evaluation datasets and regression suites.
Ability to create and maintain test automation for data intelligence platforms (unit, integration, end-to-end).
Experience with engineering best practices (code reviews, CI/CD).
Strong collaboration skills for identifying requirements and taking solutions from design to production.
specs.hook: Pure Storage is aggressively expanding its data management capabilities into the AI era; securing top-tier AI QA talent is paramount to de-risk their new intelligent data platform and accelerate market penetration.
specs.scope: Senior Individual Contributor role, collaborating closely with engineering teams.

roles.title: AI Engineering Manager
roles.why: Pozice AI Engineering Manager v IT firmě je přesně v zaměření agentury.
roles.summary: Lead and mentor an AI Engineering team to develop and deploy state-of-the-art NLP and Computer Vision solutions, directly contributing to Everpure's intelligent data-management platform and strategic expansion into the AI era.

must: Strong expertise in NLP and Computer Vision
Experience leading and mentoring AI engineers/data scientists
Hands-on technical contribution to coding and development
Defining and executing strategic AI roadmaps
Experience with high-performance AI model design, development, and deployment
specs.hook: Everpure's aggressive expansion into AI and data management requires a visionary AI Engineering Manager to accelerate the development of critical NLP/CV capabilities for their intelligent data platform.
specs.scope: Management role leading a team of AI engineers and data scientists, with significant hands-on technical contribution.
